recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-33941 unless the work group separately decides examples should illustrate these optional outputs; the authoritative OperationDefinitions already carry the requested behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-33941 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested optional $validate-code output parameters code, system, and version so clients can identify the source of a returned display, plus an optional codeableConcept output when validating CodeableConcept inputs, with code/system/version populated when possible for code or Coding validation and codeableConcept populated when possible for CodeableConcept validation.
initial_application: Git commit 0cf5d1b23e6de5f4134a6ae42b58c6846cd269e1 applied FHIR-33941 by updating source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-validate-code.xml and source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml to add the four optional output parameters and conformance wording. The current source retains those changes.
additional_context: CodeSystem and ValueSet are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and their operation-list files reference the validate-code OperationDefinitions, so the checked XML files are in build scope. FHIR-33943 is part of the same $validate-code proposal set but covers the separate issues output parameter and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-41431 adjusted nearby ValueSet/$validate-code inferSystem wording without changing the FHIR-33941 outputs. Zulip and Confluence evidence aligns with the Jira decision and did not reveal a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were modified because both affected operation definitions already define out parameters code, system, version, and codeableConcept with the requested descriptions and SHOULD wording.
